page.layout: One printed page, cut at the right edge: title block at top across the page; below it a table of three columns (Cap. | Vers. | Pag.) with a fourth column of Roman numerals beyond a vertical rule at the right; section headings (GENESIS, EXODUS, LEVITICUS, NUMERI, DEUTERONOMIUM, JUDICES, RUTH, I REGUM, II REGUM, I CHRON., JOB) set between the entries.; One printed column of index entries, left portion of a page; the heading lines run across the top, the list of Scripture references runs down the left, with page numbers to the right of some lines cut off at the scan edge.; One column of right-aligned page references (numbers with dashes and "seq.") running down the right side of a narrow strip; a fragment of a heading "TA" at the upper left, cut off. No running text, no margin notes.
page.notes: The leftmost figures are partly cut off at the left edge; the numbers "3, seq." and "305" and "318" are uncertain. The heading fragment "TA-" is cut off. Dashes after the numbers are printed leaders and are shown as stops.
